scenario: A clinic has one vial of antivenom. Dr. Rivera must give the antivenom to either one child or three adult patients, but not both. If Dr. Rivera gives the antivenom to the child, the child has an 80% chance of survival. If Dr. Rivera gives the antivenom to the three adult patients, each of the three adult patients has a 60% chance of survival. The patients who do not receive the antivenom will die.
